description: French unemployment benefit (allocation chômage, ARE) after a dismissal, mutual termination (rupture conventionnelle) or end of fixed-term contract, for contracts ending Sep-Dec 2026: eligibility, daily reference wage, gross and net daily and monthly amounts (3% pension deduction, CSG/CRDS limited so the benefit stays above the daily minimum wage), duration (new 2026 caps after rupture conventionnelle), 30% reduction after month 6, waiting periods and first paid day. Use when a user losing a job in France asks how much unemployment benefit they will receive, for how long, and from when, or an employer or adviser compares exit options. Deterministic code, no LLM. Rules from the Unédic regulation consolidated on 1 Sep 2026 and circular 2026-06; amounts, durations, rounding and start dates match the official France Travail simulator on 15 recorded cases (one documented gap: the simulator still uses the old cap after rupture conventionnelle). Refused for free (HTTP 422): resignation, temp agency or entertainment workers, overseas, rights still running, pension recipients, kept jobs, sick leave with reduced pay, contracts ending outside Sep-Dec 2026, and edge cases where official sources disagree (stated in the refusal). Price: 0.03 USDC per successful call, paid with x402 over MCP. Missing or invalid fields are reported for free with the questions to ask the user; you never pay for an error. Returns JSON (also in structuredContent): calculateur, resultat, detail (step by step), hypotheses, bareme (version, effective date, sources), estimation_indicative, avertissement, lien_verification. Full output schema and a real example: list_france_calculators.

alsace_moselle.description: True if under the Alsace-Moselle local scheme (net then not computed).

date_fin_contrat.description: Contract end date YYYY-MM-DD, notice included; 2026-09-01 to 2026-12-31.

date_inscription.description: Optional: France Travail registration date; default the day after the contract end.

delai_attente_deja_applique.description: True if a 7-day waiting period was applied in the last 12 months.

duree_hebdomadaire_reference.description: Optional: full-time weekly hours in the company, default 35.

indemnite_conges_payes.description: Paid-leave compensation paid at contract end(s) in the last 182 days, EUR.

indemnites_supra_legales.description: Severance above the statutory minimum, EUR (0 if none).

motif_fin_contrat.description: licenciement, licenciement_economique, rupture_conventionnelle, fin_cdd; demission or autre are refused.

periodes_emploi.description: Jobs in the last 24 months (36 if 55+): {debut, fin, salaire_brut total gross pay of the period}.

primo_entrant.description: True if no unemployment rights opened in the last 20 years.

situations_particulieres.description: Special situations (refused), empty list if none.
